versions.name: Change of Winds
versions.text: Look at the next 2 cards in your deck and choose one. Send it to the bottom of your deck and give it -1 cost. Draw a card.
versions.note: Not listed in Version History for this card; assumed Beta 55.0 (in effect when the tracker saw it, 2021-02-01).

versions.name: Change of Winds
versions.text: Look at the next 2 cards of your deck. Give them -1 {{COST}}. Choose one to draw. Send the other to the bottom of your deck.

versions.name: Change of Winds
versions.text: Look at the top 2 cards in your deck and choose one to draw. Send the other to the bottom of your deck and give both -1 {{COST}}.
versions.note: Not listed in Version History for this card; changed between Beta 97.0 and Beta 123.0 (the tracker last saw the old card on 2024-07-15, the new one on 2026-10-18); shown at Beta 123.0.
